description: The bar chart compares the performance of different language models across various evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation metrics, which include PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 0.42 to 1.00. The RedWhale model, represented by the dark blue bars, shows a performance score of 0.46 for PT-EVAL, 0.52 for KoBEST-BQ, 0.56 for KoBEST-CP, 0.54 for KoBEST-HS, 0.69 for KoBEST-SN, and 0.57 for AVG. The EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model, represented by the light blue bars, has a performance score of 0.70 for PT-EVAL, 0.74 for KoBEST-BQ, 0.73 for KoBEST-CP, 0.73 for KoBEST-HS, 0.73 for KoBEST-SN, and 0.61 for AVG. The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model, represented by the grey bars, has a performance score of 1.00 for all evaluation metrics. The chart is sorted in descending order of performance, with the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model having the highest performance score.
